title: Act: Add layer order, render context, SceneObject entity and buildScene
summary: Create generic layered scene construction from SceneDef.
description: Implement the layer depth table, a structural RenderContext interface that Phaser adapts to, the SceneObject entity and buildScene that creates entities from getSceneView output. Add a thin Phaser WorldScene adapter.
acceptance_criteria: buildScene returns entities sorted by layer depth
WorldScene.create builds from the Zustand store state
technical_constraints: import type only from phaser outside WorldScene
definition_of_done: Files compile under npm run typecheck

steps.action: Export LAYER_ORDER as the six layer names, LAYER_DEPTH mapping background 0, furniture 100, objects 200, characters 300, effects 400, ui 500, and layerDepth(layer?: string) returning the mapped depth or the objects depth for undefined or unknown names.

Declare interface DisplayHandle with setPosition(x,y), setScale(s), setDepth(d), setOrigin(x,y), setVisible(v), setTint(color), clearTint(), setInteractive(bounds?), on(event:'pointerover'|'pointerout'|'pointerdown', cb), destroy(); declare RenderContext with addImage(textureKey,x,y): DisplayHandle, addLabel(text,x,y): DisplayHandle, hasTexture(key): boolean, addOverlay(color,alpha): DisplayHandle, addParticles(textureKey,count): DisplayHandle, fade(direction:'in'|'out', durationMs:number, done:()=>void): void.
steps.expected: Types compile; no runtime import of phaser

steps.action: Create class SceneObject constructed with (ctx: RenderContext, view: SceneObjectView, textureKey: string); it calls ctx.addImage(textureKey, view.position?.x ?? 0, view.position?.y ?? 0), setScale(view.scale ?? 1), setDepth(layerDepth(view.layer)); expose readonly id, layer, handle; add destroy() calling handle.destroy().
steps.expected: Entity stores id and positioned handle

steps.action: Export buildScene(ctx, scene: SceneDef, state: GameState, resolveTexture: (assetId?: string) => string): BuiltScene; call getSceneView(state, scene) from engine/scene.ts, map each view to new SceneObject(ctx, view, resolveTexture(view.asset)), sort by layerDepth with a stable sort, return {entities, destroy()} where destroy destroys all entities.
steps.expected: One entity per visible object, ordered by depth

steps.action: Create class WorldScene extends Phaser.Scene (key 'WorldScene') whose create() builds a RenderContext adapter over this.add.image/this.add.text, reads useGameStore.getState().state and runtime content scene, calls buildScene and stores the result; on SHUTDOWN call destroy().
steps.expected: WorldScene instantiates and builds without error when Phaser is mocked
